description: How a browser turns HTML/CSS/JS into pixels, how to read a JavaScript error and its stack trace, console debugging, and two guided debugging challenges.
levelTitle: Level 1: Core Web Standards & Styling Architecture

lessons.title: Meet Your Browser DevTools
lessons.description: Get comfortable with browser DevTools and learn what the Elements, Console, Network, and Sources panels are for before using them to debug real problems.
lessons.originalIntent: Get comfortable with browser DevTools and learn what the Elements, Console, Network, and Sources panels are for before using them to debug real problems.

lessons.title: Inspecting HTML with Elements
lessons.description: Use the Elements panel to inspect the live DOM, experiment with HTML and CSS changes, and learn the difference between temporary browser edits and changes to your actual source code.
lessons.originalIntent: Use the Elements panel to inspect the live DOM, experiment with HTML and CSS changes, and learn the difference between temporary browser edits and changes to your actual source code.

lessons.title: Understanding the Console
lessons.description: A live message board attached to the page: what shows up there automatically, and how to tell a normal log apart from a warning or an error at a glance.
lessons.originalIntent: A live message board attached to the page: what shows up there automatically, and how to tell a normal log apart from a warning or an error at a glance.

lessons.title: Understanding Network Requests
lessons.description: Learn how to use the Network panel to see what a webpage requests, what comes back, whether a request succeeded, and how network evidence helps explain frontend problems.
lessons.originalIntent: Learn how to use the Network panel to see what a webpage requests, what comes back, whether a request succeeded, and how network evidence helps explain frontend problems.

lessons.title: Your First Debugging Exercise
lessons.description: Put Elements and Console together in a guided debugging drill: inspect the page, identify evidence, explain the cause, and make the smallest fix instead of guessing.
lessons.originalIntent: Put Elements and Console together in a guided debugging drill: inspect the page, identify evidence, explain the cause, and make the smallest fix instead of guessing.
